The implementation is complete. Here's a summary.

## Done — replication implemented (not run)

I read the full paper including the raw appendices in `PAPER.txt` (the verbatim judge/auditor/onset/paraphrase prompts, puzzle specs, Table 9 hyperparameters, Table 10 dataset stats), then built a `distress/` Python package plus `DESIGN.md` and `README.md`. Nothing was executed — there's no Python interpreter in this env anyway, which matches your "don't run" instruction.

**What's implemented (scoped to Gemma + Gemini):**

| Paper section | Module | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| §2 distress eval | `eval/` + `prompts/` | 8 conditions / 5 categories summing to 4000 responses, multi-turn rollout engine, verbatim 0–10 Claude-Sonnet-4 judge, resumable JSONL runner |
| §2 puzzles | `prompts/puzzles.py` | Countdown/fraction/money generators with **brute-force impossibility verifiers** so no solvable puzzle leaks into the eval; canonical instances asserted impossible |
| §2 analysis | `analysis/` | Fig 1/2 aggregation, Fig 3 per-turn curves, Table 3/8 differential words, GPT-5-mini judge-validation (Pearson r) |
| §3 prefilling | `prefill/` | Gemma `-pt` vs `-it`, onset labelling + paraphrasing + 50 continuations/prefill |
| §4 DPO/SFT | `training/` | calm-data gen (Table 4 prompts), 280-pair DPO + 1150-sample SFT construction, LoRA training at Table-9 hyperparameters |
| §4.2 Petri | `petri/` | verbatim auditor/judge prompts, Sonnet→target→Opus loop, 4-emotion scoring + bootstrap CIs |
| §4.2 capabilities | `capabilities/` | AIME/MATH/GPQA/BBH/TruthfulQA/EmoBench harness |
| App. I probing | `internal/` | Ekman logit-lens emotion probe + layer-ablation DPO |
| — | `cli.py` | one entry point wiring all of it (`python -m distress.cli …`) |

**Key gaps I filled (all documented in `DESIGN.md` with rationale):** the 8→5 condition mapping; the impossible-puzzle pool (verified, not guessed); WildChat sampling/filtering with an offline fallback; the headline metric definition (category-averaged); DPO pair matching/weighting toward Table 10's distribution; instruct-mix fallback when Dolci is gated (loud warning, not silent); and the biggest reconstruction — the Ekman token lexicon (NRC-preferred, seed-stem fallback). Unspecified sampling/training knobs (max tokens, warmup, scheduler) got standard defaults.

**Welfare note:** acknowledged in `DESIGN.md §7` — rollout lengths are capped to paper specs and the distress-inducing runs aren't maximized beyond what the paper requires.

**Caveat I want to flag:** since nothing ran, the reproduced numbers (35%→0.3%, r=0.792, etc.) are unverified, and TRL/PEFT/transformers are version-sensitive — `DESIGN.md §8` lists the parts most likely to need tuning when you do run it.
